title: Mercury's perihelion over a century, the Sun and Mercury alone
note: Fitted: 42.9807″ a century, against 42.9805″ (limit 10⁻⁴ of it); Newtonian -0.0000″ (limit 0.001″). The perihelion wobbles within each orbit, as the closest point of an orbit perturbed by relativity does; the fit is over 36,525 daily samples.
